But in the past few months, she has [43] into our neighbor's garden to pick leaves. I didn't want to upset her. I [44] tried to explain that our neighbor might not want their plants to be [45], but she still got sensitive. Consequently, I wrote a note to my neighbor and [46]. questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。前文提到有特殊需要的女儿有一种寻找心理安慰（finding comfort）的独特方式，后文提到这能给她带来快乐（brings her joy）。结合选项，她在摘叶子这件事中感到“高兴、愉悦”。因此选 delighted（高兴的）。易错点：虽然 delighted 通常搭配 with/at/by，但在此语境中表达“乐于做某事”，D选项在逻辑上最为契合。
questions.supplement:
A(proud)：语境句：She was proud of her daughter's achievements. 固定搭配：be proud of, do sb proud
B(careful)：语境句：You must be careful in handling these fragile items. 固定搭配：be careful with, careful consideration
C(grateful)：语境句：I am deeply grateful for your continuous support. 固定搭配：be grateful to sb for sth, deeply grateful
D(delighted)：语境句：We were delighted to hear about your success. 固定搭配：be delighted with/at/to do sth, highly delighted

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。句意：摘叶子这件事并没有带来“伤害”（harm），所以妻子和我从未阻止过她。选项中只有 harm 符合不阻止她的逻辑原因。
questions.supplement:
A(gift)：语境句：He has a special gift for learning languages. 固定搭配：have a gift for, birthday gift
B(thrill)：语境句：Winning the competition gave her a huge thrill. 固定搭配：the thrill of, thrill seeker
C(fun)：语境句：We had a lot of fun at the summer camp. 固定搭配：make fun of, for fun
D(harm)：语境句：Eating too much junk food can do harm to your health. 固定搭配：do harm to, mean no harm

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。根据上下文，女儿由于有特殊需要，她“溜达、漫步”到了邻居家的花园里去摘叶子。wander（漫步、游荡）最符合她无意且随意的行为特征。
questions.supplement:
A(wandered)：语境句：The little boy wandered away from his parents in the crowd. 固定搭配：wander around, wander off
B(dug)：语境句：They dug a deep hole to plant the tree. 固定搭配：dig into, dig up
C(looked)：语境句：She looked at the beautiful painting for a long time. 固定搭配：look forward to, look into
D(turned)：语境句：The weather turned cold suddenly. 固定搭配：turn out, turn into

questions.explanation: 本题考查副词辨析。前文提到父亲“不想让她难过（didn't want to upset her）”，因此他在解释时试图“委婉地、小心翼翼地”进行。delicately（委婉地，微妙地）符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(delicately)：语境句：He delicately raised the sensitive issue during the meeting. 固定搭配：handle delicately, delicately balanced
B(seriously)：语境句：The government needs to take this problem seriously. 固定搭配：take sth seriously, seriously injured
C(hardly)：语境句：I could hardly hear what he was saying due to the noise. 固定搭配：hardly ever, can hardly
D(anxiously)：语境句：The students waited anxiously for their exam results. 固定搭配：wait anxiously, look anxiously

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。父亲向女儿解释：邻居可能不希望他们的植物被“打扰/破坏”（disturbed）。女儿摘叶子的行为对植物来说是一种打扰，选 disturbed 最恰当。
questions.supplement:
A(watered)：语境句：The plants need to be watered every other day. 固定搭配：water the plants, mouth watered
B(designed)：语境句：The building was designed by a famous architect. 固定搭配：be designed for, well-designed
C(disturbed)：语境句：Please do not enter the room so as not to be disturbed. 固定搭配：feel disturbed, easily disturbed
D(grown)：语境句：These vegetables are grown locally. 固定搭配：fully grown, home-grown

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。因为女儿擅自去邻居家摘了叶子，给邻居造成了影响，所以父亲写纸条向邻居“道歉”（apologized）。
questions.supplement:
A(greeted)：语境句：The host greeted the guests warmly at the door. 固定搭配：greet sb with a smile, properly greeted
B(apologized)：语境句：She apologized for being late to the important meeting. 固定搭配：apologize to sb for sth, sincerely apologize
C(complained)：语境句：Customers complained about the poor quality of the product. 固定搭配：complain about, complain to sb
D(worried)：语境句：He was worried about his upcoming job interview. 固定搭配：be worried about, deeply worried

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语。父亲询问可以买些什么植物来“弥补”邻居的损失。make up for 意为“弥补”，完全符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(take care of)：语境句：She stayed at home to take care of her sick mother. 固定搭配：take good care of, take care of oneself
B(catch up with)：语境句：He had to work hard to catch up with his classmates. 固定搭配：catch up with sb/sth
C(make up for)：语境句：Nothing can make up for the loss of a loved one. 固定搭配：make up for lost time, make up for a mistake
D(break away from)：语境句：He decided to break away from his old habits. 固定搭配：break away from tradition

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。后文提到邻居说“不用担心，几盆植物算不了什么”，这种善意包容的回复让原本担忧的父亲感到极其“安慰”（comforting）。
questions.supplement:
A(convincing)：语境句：The lawyer presented a convincing argument to the jury. 固定搭配：convincing evidence, sound convincing
B(comforting)：语境句：It is comforting to know that I am not alone in this struggle. 固定搭配：comforting words, a comforting thought
C(interesting)：语境句：This book provides an interesting perspective on history. 固定搭配：find sth interesting, sound interesting
D(disappointing)：语境句：The team's performance in the final match was disappointing. 固定搭配：deeply disappointing, somewhat disappointing

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。邻居说：“她对我们来说就像自己的孩子一样亲切”。be dear to sb 意为“对某人来说是珍贵/亲切的”。
questions.supplement:
A(shy)：语境句：The shy boy hid behind his mother when strangers approached. 固定搭配：be shy of, feel shy
B(kind)：语境句：It was very kind of you to help me with the luggage. 固定搭配：be kind to, a kind of
C(dear)：语境句：The memories of my childhood are very dear to me. 固定搭配：dear to sb, hold dear
D(friendly)：语境句：The locals are very friendly to tourists. 固定搭配：be friendly to, user-friendly

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。邻居非常宽容，表示只要摘叶子能带给她快乐，随时“欢迎”（welcome）她来这里。
questions.supplement:
A(remarkable)：语境句：She has made remarkable progress in her English study. 固定搭配：remarkable achievement, truly remarkable
B(brave)：语境句：It was brave of him to rush into the burning building. 固定搭配：brave enough to, put on a brave face
C(creative)：语境句：The company encourages creative thinking among its employees. 固定搭配：creative ideas, highly creative
D(welcome)：语境句：You are always welcome to visit us whenever you are in town. 固定搭配：be welcome to do sth, a warm welcome

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。根据上下文，每当女儿“靠近”（nears）邻居家花园时，邻居都会亲切地和她打招呼。near 在此作动词，表示“接近”。
questions.supplement:
A(nears)：语境句：As the deadline nears, everyone is working overtime. 固定搭配：draw near, near completion
B(desires)：语境句：He strongly desires to further his education abroad. 固定搭配：express a desire, deep desire
C(protects)：语境句：The new law protects consumers from fraud. 固定搭配：protect from, environmental protection
D(decorates)：语境句：She decorates her living room with beautiful flowers every week. 固定搭配：decorate with, interior decoration

questions.explanation: 本题考查介词短语。面对邻居的善意，父亲一家作为“回报”（in return），经常制作一些家庭点心送给他们以表感激。
questions.supplement:
A(in person)：语境句：You need to go to the office and apply for it in person. 固定搭配：appear in person, meet in person
B(in return)：语境句：I helped him with his math, and he taught me French in return. 固定搭配：in return for, ask for nothing in return
C(on time)：语境句：Please make sure you submit the report on time. 固定搭配：arrive on time, right on time
D(on purpose)：语境句：I didn't break the vase on purpose; it was an accident. 固定搭配：do sth on purpose, not on purpose

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。homemade treats（自制的小点心/美食）是西方社会常用来答谢邻居礼物的经典表达。
questions.supplement:
A(trees)：语境句：They planted many apple trees in the backyard. 固定搭配：plant trees, fruit trees
B(treats)：语境句：The bakery is famous for its delicious sweet treats. 固定搭配：tasty treats, homemade treats
C(stories)：语境句：The grandfather told fascinating bedtime stories to the kids. 固定搭配：tell stories, short stories
D(toys)：语境句：The children left their toys all over the floor. 固定搭配：educational toys, soft toys

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。女儿的叶子作品起到了一个“提醒物”（reminder）的作用，不断提醒人们关于善意和包容的力量。
questions.supplement:
A(reminder)：语境句：The monument serves as a reminder of those who died in the war. 固定搭配：a gentle reminder, serve as a reminder
B(tradition)：语境句：It is a tradition to eat dumplings during the Spring Festival. 固定搭配：keep up a tradition, by tradition
C(standard)：语境句：The hotel offers a high standard of service. 固定搭配：meet the standard, living standard
D(target)：语境句：The company has set a target to reduce emissions by 20%. 固定搭配：hit the target, target audience

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。邻居不仅没有责怪特殊需要的女儿破坏植物，反而非常欢迎她，体现了邻里的善良（kindness）与“接纳/包容”（acceptance）。
questions.supplement:
A(knowledge)：语境句：Reading widely helps expand your general knowledge. 固定搭配：a thirst for knowledge, professional knowledge
B(wisdom)：语境句：The old man is known for his great wisdom and experience. 固定搭配：words of wisdom, conventional wisdom
C(acceptance)：语境句：The new policy has gained wide acceptance among the public. 固定搭配：gain acceptance, social acceptance
D(imagination)：语境句：The author's vivid imagination makes the story fascinating. 固定搭配：capture the imagination, beyond imagination

vocab_pack.definition_en: the particular needs of people who have physical or mental disabilities
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 特殊需求（常指身体或智力残疾人士的需求）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作介词with的宾语，固定搭配live with special needs表示「与特殊需求共存」，此处一般现在时，主语第三人称单数lives。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school provides extra support for children with special needs.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这所学校为有特殊需求的儿童提供额外支持。
vocab_pack.from_passage: lives with special needs

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get relief or consolation from something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中动名词短语finding comfort作介词of的宾语，表示「找到安慰的方式」。
vocab_pack.example_en: She often finds comfort in listening to soft music.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她经常通过听轻柔的音乐找到安慰。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a unique way of finding comfort

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make or shape something into a particular form
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中现在分词fashioning作伴随状语，them为宾语，into引出结果，表示「把它们做成图案」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Children can fashion clay into various animals.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 孩子们可以把黏土捏成各种动物。
vocab_pack.from_passage: fashioning them into designs

vocab_pack.definition_en: requirements related to the senses (touch, sight, etc.) for comfort or regulation
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 感官需求（通过触摸、视觉等获得舒适或调节的需求）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作动词fulfill的宾语，形容词sensory修饰needs，表示「满足她的感官需求」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many children with autism have strong sensory needs that must be met.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多自闭症儿童有强烈的感官需求需要得到满足。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to fulfill her sensory needs

vocab_pack.definition_en: cause no damage or danger
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语It第三人称单数，brings为谓语，no harm为宾语，表示「它不带来伤害」。
vocab_pack.example_en: This gentle exercise brings no harm to your joints.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种温和的运动不会对你的关节造成伤害。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It brings no harm

vocab_pack.definition_en: designed exclusively for a particular purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中过去分词作定语，修饰garden，表示「一个专用的花园」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company set up a dedicated team for the new project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公司为新项目设立了一个专门团队。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a dedicated garden

vocab_pack.definition_en: to enter a place unintentionally or without a clear purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时，has wandered into，wandered为过去分词，表示「过去几个月里」她曾无意中走进邻居的花园。
vocab_pack.example_en: The cat wandered into the kitchen looking for food.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那只猫溜进厨房找食物。
vocab_pack.from_passage: she has wandered into our neighbor's garden

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a careful, gentle, or sensitive way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词修饰动词tried，表示「我小心翼翼地尝试解释」。
vocab_pack.example_en: She delicately refused the invitation so as not to offend anyone.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她婉言谢绝了邀请，以免冒犯任何人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I delicately tried to explain

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make someone feel unhappy, worried, or angry
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中不定式作want的宾语，upset为及物动词原形，表示「我不想让她不高兴」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Don't upset your mother with bad news before dinner.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不要在晚餐前用坏消息让你母亲心烦。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I didn't want to upset her

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become easily offended or emotionally reactive
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 系动词get + 形容词sensitive构成系表结构，一般过去时，got为过去式，表示「她变得敏感了」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He gets sensitive whenever people mention his grades.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每当人们提到他的成绩，他就会变得敏感。
vocab_pack.from_passage: she still got sensitive

vocab_pack.definition_en: as a result; therefore
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作状语，置于句首，引出结果，表示「因此，我给邻居写了便条道歉」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He missed the bus; consequently, he was late for work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他错过了公交车，因此上班迟到了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Consequently, I wrote a note to my neighbor and apologized.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to say you are sorry for something wrong you have done
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，apologized为过去式，此处省略了to my neighbor（前文已出现），表示「我向邻居写了便条并道了歉」。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should apologize for breaking the window.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你应当为打破窗户道歉。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I wrote a note to my neighbor and apologized.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to compensate for something bad or lost
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语to make up for作buy的目的状语，表示「买什么植物来弥补损失」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He worked extra hours to make up for the time he lost.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他加班来弥补失去的时间。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to make up for the loss

vocab_pack.definition_en: the fact of losing something or the amount that is lost
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作介词for的宾语，定冠词the表示特指，即女儿摘叶子造成的损失。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company reported a significant loss this quarter.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公司本季度报告了重大损失。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to make up for the loss

vocab_pack.definition_en: making someone feel less sad, worried, or upset
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作表语，与was truly构成系表结构，表示「邻居的回应确实令人安慰」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her comforting words helped me through the hard time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她安慰的话帮助我度过了艰难时期。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Our neighbor's response was truly comforting.

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to say that something is unnecessary
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句型There's no need (for sb) to do sth的省略形式，句中There's no need to worry意为「没必要担心」。
vocab_pack.example_en: There's no need to shout; I can hear you clearly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 没必要大喊大叫，我听得清楚。
vocab_pack.from_passage: There's no need to worry.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be loved and valued by someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中as dear to us as为比较结构，dear是形容词，to us表示对象，as...as表示同等程度，意为「她对我们就像我们自己的孩子一样珍贵」。
vocab_pack.example_en: This old photo is very dear to my grandmother.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这张老照片对我祖母非常珍贵。
vocab_pack.from_passage: She's as dear to us as our own child.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be unimportant or trivial
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 系动词are + nothing作表语，一般现在时，主语A few plants复数，表示「几株植物不算什么」。
vocab_pack.example_en: A small delay is nothing compared to the success of the project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 与项目的成功相比，小小的延误不算什么。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A few plants are nothing.

vocab_pack.definition_en: received gladly; allowed to come or do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作表语，She's welcome here表示「她在这里是受欢迎的」，一般现在时。
vocab_pack.example_en: You are always welcome to join our discussion.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 随时欢迎你加入我们的讨论。
vocab_pack.from_passage: She's welcome here whenever it brings her joy.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause happiness or pleasure
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语it第三人称单数，brings为谓语，her为间接宾语，joy为直接宾语，表示「它给她带来快乐」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Listening to music brings joy to many people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 听音乐给许多人带来快乐。
vocab_pack.from_passage: whenever it brings her joy

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come close to something in distance or time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语daughter第三人称单数，nears为动词near的第三人称单数形式，表示「当女儿靠近邻居的花园时」。
vocab_pack.example_en: As the deadline nears, she becomes more anxious.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 随着截止日期临近，她变得更加焦虑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: every time our daughter nears the neighbor's garden

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a kind, gentle, or friendly way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词修饰动词greets，表示「邻居和蔼地跟她打招呼」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher kindly helped the student carry the books.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师和蔼地帮学生搬书。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the neighbor greets her kindly

vocab_pack.definition_en: as a way of reciprocating or responding to something given or done
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作插入语/状语，说明「我们经常做自制点心作为回报」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He helped me move, and I cooked dinner in return.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他帮我搬家，我做饭作为回报。
vocab_pack.from_passage: We, in return, often make homemade treats

vocab_pack.definition_en: made at home rather than bought from a shop
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语修饰treats，表示「自制的小吃」。
vocab_pack.example_en: She brought homemade cookies to the party.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她带了自制饼干来聚会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: homemade treats

vocab_pack.definition_en: an action that shows thanks
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 感激的表示，表达谢意的举动
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中介词短语as a gesture of gratitude作方式状语，表示「作为感激的表示」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Sending flowers is a common gesture of gratitude.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 送花是一种常见的表达谢意的方式。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as a gesture of gratitude

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make a place or group feel more friendly and caring
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语friendship第三人称单数，spreads为谓语，warmth为宾语，表示「这种友谊在社区中传播温暖」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her smile spreads warmth wherever she goes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的微笑所到之处都传递着温暖。
vocab_pack.from_passage: spreads warmth in the community

vocab_pack.definition_en: to function or serve as something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语creations复数，work为动词原形，as介词引出作用，表示「女儿的叶子作品充当了提醒物」。
vocab_pack.example_en: This old building now works as a museum.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这栋老建筑现在用作博物馆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: our daughter's leaf creations work as a reminder

vocab_pack.definition_en: something that makes you remember or think about someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中a reminder of the power...作宾语，reminder为名词，后接介词of表示提醒的内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: This photo is a reminder of our happy days together.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这张照片是提醒我们曾共度快乐时光的纪念。
vocab_pack.from_passage: work as a reminder of the power of kindness and acceptance

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of treating someone as part of a group and approving of them
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中与kindness并列作介词of的宾语，表示「善良与接纳的力量」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school promotes acceptance of students from different backgrounds.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学校倡导接纳来自不同背景的学生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the power of kindness and acceptance

vocab_pack.definition_en: to satisfy a need, desire, or requirement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中不定式to fulfill作目的状语，表示「为了满足她的感官需求」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Working as a teacher helps him fulfill his desire to help others.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当老师帮助他实现帮助他人的愿望。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to fulfill her sensory needs

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词。句中介词短语的宾语并列：food, shelter and even ______。需填入名词作宾语，故用 inspire 的名词形式 inspiration（灵感）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(inspiration)：语境句：Nature has always been a great source of inspiration for artists. 固定搭配：draw inspiration from, a flash of inspiration。原词inspire其它变形：inspired(adj.), inspiring(adj.)

questions.explanation: 本题考查副词。此处修饰动词的过去分词（用作形容词）respected，应当用副词形式 highly，意为“高度地，极大地”。highly respected 是常见搭配。
questions.supplement: 正确形(highly)：语境句：The professor is highly respected by all his students. 固定搭配：highly successful, highly recommend。原词high其它变形：height(n.), heighten(v.)

questions.explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词。连词 or 连接两个并列成分，后半部分为 capturing...，故前半部分也应使用现在分词形式 Painting。作方式或伴随状语，因位于句首，首字母大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(Painting)：语境句：Painting requires a lot of patience and practice. 固定搭配：oil painting, traditional Chinese painting。原词paint其它变形：painter(n.), painted(adj.)

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词复数。a variety of（各种各样的）后面通常接可数名词的复数形式，故填 views（视角，风景）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(views)：语境句：They climbed to the top of the mountain to enjoy the beautiful views. 固定搭配：point of view, exchange views。原词view其它变形：viewer(n.), review(v./n.)

questions.explanation: 本题考查冠词。后文 14th-century Italian collection 是单数可数名词，泛指“一个”14世纪的意大利藏品，作同位语，以辅音音素开头，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：He is a 14-year-old student from China. 固定搭配：a collection of, a number of。原词None其它变形：无

questions.explanation: 本题考查介词。be illustrated with 意为“用……装饰/配图”，是固定搭配。句意为这本抄本的一些章节用象征善恶的昆虫作了丰富的插图说明。
questions.supplement: 正确形(with)：语境句：The book is richly illustrated with colourful photos. 固定搭配：be illustrated with, equip with。原词None其它变形：无

questions.explanation: 本题考查谓语动词。句子主语是 the small animals，由 and 连接与前半句（谓语 were）并列。描述过去发生的事实或客观存在（呼应 were richly illustrated），应用一般过去时 served。
questions.supplement: 正确形(served)：语境句：The old building served as a hospital during the war. 固定搭配：serve as, serve the people。原词serve其它变形：service(n.), servant(n.)

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词。修饰其后的名词 celebration（庆典），需把所给名词 significance 变为形容词 significant（意义重大的）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(significant)：语境句：This discovery will have a significant impact on medical research. 固定搭配：significant progress, highly significant。原词significance其它变形：significantly(adv.), signify(v.)

questions.explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词。attract sb/sth to do sth（吸引某人做某事），不定式表目的或结果。中国画笔墨吸引了来自不同文化的目光“来欣赏（to appreciate）”一花一叶一虫中的自然世界。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to appreciate)：语境句：We went to the art gallery to appreciate the masterpieces. 固定搭配：appreciate doing sth, fully appreciate。原词appreciate其它变形：appreciation(n.), appreciative(adj.)

questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句。逗号后是引导非限制性定语从句的关系代词，先行词为整个主句或 macro-nature，在从句中作主语，因此填 which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：The rain stopped, which was a great relief to everyone. 固定搭配：in which, all of which。原词None其它变形：无

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be kind and giving towards someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语置于句首作状语，相当于“Being generous to”，表示原因或伴随状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is always generous to those in need.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她对有需要的人总是很慷慨。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Generous to the creatures within it

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give something to someone or make it available
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 及物动词，一般现在时，主语 nature 为第三人称单数，故谓语动词加 -s。常接双宾语或 provide sth.。
vocab_pack.example_en: The library provides a wide range of resources for students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 图书馆为学生提供广泛的资源。
vocab_pack.from_passage: nature provides food, shelter and even inspiration

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person, place, or thing that makes you want to create something or do something well
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不可数名词，此处作动词 provide 的宾语之一，由动词 inspire 派生而来。
vocab_pack.example_en: Great artists often draw inspiration from everyday life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 伟大的艺术家常常从日常生活中汲取灵感。
vocab_pack.from_passage: provides food, shelter and even inspiration

vocab_pack.definition_en: to organize and host a public display of works of art, products, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，held 是 hold 的过去式，主语 Beijing Fine Art Academy。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum will hold an exhibition of modern sculptures next month.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆下个月将举办一场现代雕塑展览。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Beijing Fine Art Academy held an exhibition in memory of Qi Baishi

vocab_pack.definition_en: as a way of remembering and honoring someone who has died
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定介词短语，后接名词/代词，表示目的。此处与 held an exhibition 搭配，说明举办展览的目的。
vocab_pack.example_en: A statue was built in memory of the national hero.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 为纪念这位民族英雄，人们建了一座雕像。
vocab_pack.from_passage: held an exhibition in memory of Qi Baishi

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be greatly admired and esteemed by many people
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态的一般现在时，is 是 be 的第三人称单数形式，highly 副词修饰 respected，表示程度。
vocab_pack.example_en: Professor Li is highly respected for his contributions to science.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 李教授因其对科学的贡献而受到高度尊敬。
vocab_pack.from_passage: who is highly respected for his traditional Chinese paintings

vocab_pack.definition_en: a style of painting originating in China, typically using ink and brush on paper or silk
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 可数名词短语，此处为复数形式，作介词 for 的宾语。paintings 是 painting 的复数。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many collectors are interested in traditional Chinese painting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多收藏家对传统中国画感兴趣。
vocab_pack.from_passage: for his traditional Chinese paintings of the small lives in nature

vocab_pack.definition_en: any living thing, especially an animal
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 可数名词复数形式，泛指自然界中的生物。
vocab_pack.example_en: The forest is home to many small creatures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这片森林是许多小生物的栖息地。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Generous to the creatures within it

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reduce or eliminate differences between two things; to connect
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 及物动词原形，用于不定式短语 to bridge the two cultures，表示目的，意为“沟通两种文化”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Educational exchanges help to bridge cultural differences.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 教育交流有助于弥合文化差异。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to bridge the two cultures

vocab_pack.definition_en: to produce a picture or design using paint
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词作状语，表示伴随动作，主语为 Qi。首字母大写因在句首。
vocab_pack.example_en: She enjoys painting landscapes in her spare time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她喜欢在闲暇时画风景画。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Painting fascinating insects or capturing colorful flowers

vocab_pack.definition_en: to record or depict something accurately in a picture, words, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词作状语，与 Painting 并列，表示伴随动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The photographer captured the beauty of sunset perfectly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 摄影师完美地捕捉到了日落的美丽。
vocab_pack.from_passage: capturing colorful flowers in a freer style

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get something from a particular place or person
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 及物动词过去式，主语 Qi 为第三人称单数，表示“从自然获取题材”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company sources raw materials from local suppliers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该公司从当地供应商处获取原材料。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Qi sourced subjects from nature

vocab_pack.definition_en: a gentle, caring, and loving feeling
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不可数名词，作动词 express 的宾语，后接介词 to，表示“对生活的柔情”。
vocab_pack.example_en: He expressed great tenderness towards his children.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他对孩子们表达了极大的温柔。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to express his tenderness to life

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to say that a statement also applies to another person or thing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定句型，系动词 is 随主语 The same 用单数，true 为形容词，of 引出比较对象。这里指西方艺术家同样如此。
vocab_pack.example_en: Success requires hard work, and the same is true of studying a foreign language.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 成功需要努力，学习外语也是如此。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The same is true of Western artists

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start to do something or to seek help from something or someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 短语动词过去式，turned 是 turn 的过去式。此处表示“转而求助自然”。
vocab_pack.example_en: When in trouble, she always turns to her family for support.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 遇到困难时，她总是向家人寻求支持。
vocab_pack.from_passage: who have also turned to nature

vocab_pack.definition_en: a number of different kinds of the same thing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 数量短语，修饰名词 views，表示多种观点。
vocab_pack.example_en: The store offers a variety of fresh fruits.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家商店提供多种新鲜水果。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to present a variety of views

vocab_pack.definition_en: shared interests, beliefs, or opinions that two or more people can agree on
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，与介词 based on 搭配，构成分词短语 Based on the common ground，作状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The two parties finally found common ground on the issue.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 双方最终在这个问题上找到了共同点。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Based on the common ground

vocab_pack.definition_en: to display a clear difference between two or more things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，showed 是 show 的过去式，后接名词短语 a contrast between ... and ...。
vocab_pack.example_en: The report shows a sharp contrast between urban and rural areas.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这份报告显示了城乡之间的鲜明对比。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the celebration showed a contrast between Qi's paintings and the images

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be decorated or explained with many pictures, details, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态的过去时，were 是 be 的复数过去式，illustrated 是过去分词，richly 副词修饰，with 引出插图内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: The book is richly illustrated with photographs from the expedition.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这本书配有大量来自探险的照片插图。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Some chapters of the Codex were richly illustrated with insects

vocab_pack.definition_en: to represent or stand for something, especially an abstract idea
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词作后置定语，修饰 insects，表示“象征善与恶的昆虫”。
vocab_pack.example_en: A dove often symbolizes peace.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鸽子常象征和平。
vocab_pack.from_passage: insects symbolizing good and evil

vocab_pack.definition_en: to gain or develop a particular significance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语，acquiring 是 acquire 的现在分词，与 different meanings 构成动宾结构，作让步状语（despite 引导）。
vocab_pack.example_en: Words can acquire different meanings over time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 词语会随着时间的推移获得不同的含义。
vocab_pack.from_passage: despite acquiring different meanings

vocab_pack.definition_en: to function as a means of communication or transmission for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，served 是 serve 的过去式，as a channel for 组成介词短语，后接名词短语 a dialogue。
vocab_pack.example_en: Social media can serve as a channel for spreading information.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 社交媒体可以充当传播信息的渠道。
vocab_pack.from_passage: served as a channel for a dialogue across time and space

vocab_pack.definition_en: spanning different periods of history and physical distances
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作定语/状语，修饰 a dialogue，意为“跨越时间和空间的对话”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Great works of art can communicate across time and space.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 伟大的艺术作品可以跨越时空进行交流。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a dialogue across time and space

vocab_pack.definition_en: to repeat or reflect an idea, feeling, or style; to be similar to
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词原形，用于不定式 to echo，表示目的，意为“为了呼应这次意义重大的庆典”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new policy echoes the government's commitment to environmental protection.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新政策呼应了政府对环境保护的承诺。
vocab_pack.from_passage: To echo the significant celebration

vocab_pack.definition_en: a very pleasing and impressive visual experience
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词 In 的宾语，意为“在这场视觉盛宴中”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The exhibition was a visual feast for art lovers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这次展览对艺术爱好者来说是一场视觉盛宴。
vocab_pack.from_passage: In this visual feast

vocab_pack.definition_en: the traditional technique or style of painting with a brush in Chinese art
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 中国水墨技法；中国画笔法
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作主语，指中国画技艺。不可数。
vocab_pack.example_en: Chinese brushwork emphasizes the flow of energy and the spirit of the subject.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 中国水墨技法强调气韵和对象的精神。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Chinese brushwork attracted eyes from different cultures

vocab_pack.definition_en: to draw the attention or gaze of people from a particular group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，attracted 是 attract 的过去式，eyes 作宾语，from 引出来源（不同文化的人）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new sculpture attracted eyes from passers-by.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新雕塑吸引了路人的目光。
vocab_pack.from_passage: attracted eyes from different cultures

vocab_pack.definition_en: to recognize the good qualities of something; to enjoy or value something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 及物动词原形，用于不定式 to appreciate，表示目的，后接宾语 the natural world。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should take time to appreciate the beauty around us.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该花时间欣赏周围的美。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to appreciate the natural world in a flower, a leaf and an insect

vocab_pack.definition_en: a small, often miniature, environment or realm
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合名词，由前缀 micro- + world 构成，在句中作主语，表示“微观世界”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Under the microscope, a micro-world of incredible detail is revealed.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在显微镜下，一个极其精细的微观世界展现出来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the micro-world offers a window into macro-nature

vocab_pack.definition_en: the large-scale, overall natural world
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合名词，由前缀 macro- + nature 构成，作 into 的宾语，与 micro-world 相对。
vocab_pack.example_en: Understanding micro-worlds helps us grasp the complexity of macro-nature.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 理解微观世界有助于我们把握宏观自然的复杂性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a window into macro-nature
